source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: You can use Shokk-boosta when you choose the Big Mek’s unit to Advance in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase). Use a 6 for its Advance roll and let the unit pass through any model during that **[Advance Move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**. Once it stops, every model in the unit makes a **[Hazard roll](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls)**.

trigger.event: owner unit selected to make an Advance Move

effects.movementPermission: pass through every type of model

effects.trigger: owner unit ends that Advance Move
